# MiniMax

> MiniMax is an AI platform offering state-of-the-art multimodal models for text generation, video creation, music synthesis, and voice agents.

MiniMax develops cutting-edge AI models including M2.7 and M2.5 for text/coding, Hailuo for video generation, Music 2.5+ for music synthesis, and Speech 2.6 for voice applications. The platform emphasizes cost-efficiency, low-latency performance, and production-ready capabilities for developers and enterprises.

## Text & Language Models

- [MiniMax M2.7](https://www.minimax.io/models/text/m27): Latest LLM with self-improvement capabilities, advanced coding, reasoning, and multi-agent system support
- [MiniMax M2.5](https://www.minimax.io/models/text): State-of-the-art text model optimized for high-throughput, low-latency production with superior coding and agent capabilities
- [MiniMax M2.1 Release](https://www.minimax.io/news/minimax-m21): Enhanced multi-language programming improvements designed for real-world complex tasks
- [MiniMax M2 & Agent Launch](https://www.minimax.io/news/minimax-m2): Original M2 model and Agent framework announcement emphasizing coding excellence and cost-effectiveness

## Video Generation

- [MiniMax Hailuo 2.3](https://www.minimax.io/news/minimax-hailuo-23): Advanced video generation model with character animation and media agent capabilities for complex video performance
- [MiniMax Hailuo 02](https://www.minimax.io/news/minimax-hailuo-02): World-class video model featuring NCR architecture, native 1080p resolution, and physics mastery with record-breaking cost efficiency

## Music & Audio Generation

- [MiniMax Music 2.5+](https://www.minimax.io/news/music-25-unlock-instrumental-music): Instrumental music generation with style diversity and boundary-breaking creative capabilities
- [MiniMax Music 2.5](https://www.minimax.io/news/minimax-music-25): Comprehensive music creation model with vocal synthesis and advanced control over musical details
- [MiniMax Speech 2.6](https://www.minimax.io/news/minimax-speech-26): Ultimate voice agent with low-latency text-to-speech capabilities for real-time applications
- [MiniMax Speech 2.5](https://www.minimax.io/news/minimax-speech-25): Multilingual TTS model with enhanced expressiveness and exceptional voice cloning fidelity
- [MiniMax Music 2.0](https://www.minimax.io/news/minimax-music-20): Accessible AI music creation platform making advanced music generation available to everyone
- [MiniMax Music 1.5](https://www.minimax.io/news/minimax-music-15): Music generation model enabling 4-minute composition creation with creative control

## Conversational & Role-Play AI

- [MiniMax M2-her Deep Dive](https://www.minimax.io/news/a-deep-dive-into-the-minimax-m2-her-2): Exploration of MiniMax-M2-her role-play agent and advanced conversational AI capabilities
